text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I should hope so.

I strive to remain calm and attentive...<n>Yet I can feel
the adrenaline building.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The voting results came in the other<n>day, securing
Grass Wonder's<n>chance to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Maruzensky is on the list<n>of participants
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass's long-awaited battle with the<n>Beast is
finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what we thought.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is withdrawing from the<n>Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yes... It seems she hurt herself during<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And that's not all—it looks like she<n>was planning for
the Arima Kinen to<n>be her final send-off before
moving<n>on to the Dream Trophy League.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... I won't have a<n>chance to face
her in the Twinkle<n>Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It looks to be that way.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And what a shame it is too! I was so<n>excited to see
the Beast and her<n>Successor go head to head.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I was all set to write the article for theages covering it. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We had planned to discuss our<n>strategy to beat
Maruzensky today,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So my goal... is forever out of reach.

Grass Wonder's words come out as<n>a
barely-audible whisper... I've never<n>heard her
sound so broken.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The chance to overcome the Beast...<n>To break away
from her looming<n>shadow...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That chance... will never come again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We haven't the time to sulk, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The starting gates will open<n>regardless of who's in
them. We<n>must be prepared for the Arima Kinen,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So I think...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I think I need to go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Grass Wonder doesn't even look<n>back as she
takes off at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is tough—too tough to<n>let herself cry
where I can see her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She needs her time alone. I<n>understand that, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And then, suddenly...
Excuse me. Is Grass here, by any<n>chance?
Oh... Looks like it's just you right<n>now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What's kicking? ...is what I'd usually<n>say, but I
guess this is no time for<n>pleasantries.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know how hard you and Grass have<n>been
working to get ready for it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm deeply sorry I won't be able to<n>run. ...That's all
I've come to say.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her injury was an accident, I'm sure.<n>She isn't to
blame.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But when I consider how much this<n>meant to Grass
Wonder... I can't help<n>but feel horribly let down.
choice_data_list:
Is there any chance you'll stay in the Twinkle
Series?

Is there any chance you'll stay in the Twinkle
Series?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Unfortunately, I'm afraid not.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I made up my mind to go to the<n>Dream Trophy
Series a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The only reason you want me to stay<n>is for Grass,
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You want the two of us to race, don't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But if you ask me... now isn't the<n>right time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Grass and I shouldn't go head to<n>head just yet.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: When I saw the Japan Cup, I justknew.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's my little secret.
But, hey. Grass will be fine. Just<n>peachy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: After all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's one important thing she's<n>always had
tons and tons of.<n>Something I never had, no matter
how<n>I longed for it!
